common.no-results: No records match the selected criteria. Change or clear the filters.
common.unavailable: The information could not be loaded. Use Retry once the API is available.

filters.title: Filters
filters.invalid-period: The start date must not be later than the end date.

forms.review-fields: Some fields need your attention. Review the messages below each field.

validation.positive: Enter a value greater than zero.
validation.whole-number: Enter a whole number equal to or greater than zero.
validation.not-future: The date cannot be later than now.

api-errors.network: The Molinex API could not be reached. Check that it is running and try again.
api-errors.bad-request: The API rejected the data that was sent.
api-errors.not-found: The requested record no longer exists.
api-errors.conflict: The record conflicts with an existing one.
api-errors.server: The API had an internal error. Try again later.
api-errors.invalid-data: The API returned data that does not meet the Molinex rules.

page-not-found.title: Page not found
page-not-found.content: The address {path} does not exist in Molinex.

errors.unknown-reception: The selected reception is not registered.
errors.duplicate-batch-code: Another batch already uses this code.
errors.unknown-batch: The selected batch is not registered.
errors.record-not-found: The production record was not found.

production-overview.title: Production operations
production-overview.description: Follow raw material from reception to batches and production processes.

metrics.linked: {linked} of {total} batches linked to a reception

traceability.title: From reception to production
traceability.description: Each raw material reception, the batches created from it and the processes run on each batch.
traceability.empty: No raw material has been received yet.
traceability.no-batches: No batch has been registered for this reception.
traceability.no-processes: No production process recorded for this batch.
traceability.unlinked: These batches point to a reception that does not exist: {codes}.

receptions.title: Raw material receptions
receptions.description: Paddy rice received at the mill, by supplier and origin.
receptions.search: Search by id, supplier or origin
receptions.empty: No raw material reception has been registered.

reception-form.title: Register raw material reception
reception-form.description: Record the paddy rice that arrives at the mill. Fields marked with * are required.
reception-form.origin-hint: Place the rice comes from, for example Lambayeque.

batches.title: Production batches
batches.description: Lots of raw material followed through the production process.
batches.search: Search by code, reception, supplier or origin
batches.empty: No production batch has been registered.

batch-form.title: Create production batch
batch-form.description: Register a lot of raw material and link it to its reception. Fields marked with * are required.
batch-form.no-receptions: Register a raw material reception before creating batches.

production-records.title: Production processes
production-records.description: Processes recorded for each batch, with their weight, period and status.
production-records.empty: No production process has been recorded.

production-record-form.description: Record a production process for a batch. Fields marked with * are required.
production-record-form.edit-description: Correct the information of a production process. Its batch cannot change.
production-record-form.batch-locked: The batch of a registered process cannot be changed.
production-record-form.process-hint: For example cleaning and husking, whitening or polishing.
production-record-form.finished-hint: Leave it empty while the process is running.
production-record-form.no-batches: Create a production batch before recording production.

errors.finish-before-start: The finish cannot be earlier than the start.

production-history.title: Production history
production-history.description: Production processes by period, batch and status.
production-history.empty: There are no production processes for the selected criteria.

quality.no-processes: Record a production process before registering quality results or waste.

errors.unknown-process: The selected production process is not registered.

quality-assessments.title: Quality results
quality-assessments.description: Whole grain, broken grain and yield measured for each production process.
quality-assessments.empty: No quality result has been recorded.

quality-assessment-form.title: Record quality results
quality-assessment-form.description: Record the quality of the rice obtained in a production process. Fields marked with * are required.
quality-assessment-form.measurements-help: Values between 0 and 100 %. Whole plus broken grain cannot exceed 100 %.

errors.composition: Whole plus broken grain cannot exceed 100 %.

waste-records.title: Production waste
waste-records.description: Waste generated by each production process, filtered by batch and date.

waste-record-form.title: Record waste
waste-record-form.description: Record the waste of a production process. Its percentage is calculated from the processed weight.
waste-record-form.percentage-help: Waste quantity divided by the weight processed in the selected process.

errors.exceeds: The waste cannot exceed the weight processed in the selected process.

errors.duplicate-machine-code: Another machine already uses this code.
errors.unknown-machine: The selected machine is not registered.

machines.title: Machinery
machines.description: Machine inventory of the mill and its operational status.
machines.search: Search by code, name or model

machine-form.title: Register machine
machine-form.description: Add a machine to the mill inventory. Fields marked with * are required.
machine-form.code-hint: Unique code, stored in upper case, for example MOL-HSK-02.
machine-form.name: Name
machine-form.model-hint: Manufacturer model, for example Satake HR-10.

maintenance-history.title: Maintenance
maintenance-history.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance carried out on each machine.
maintenance-history.machine-empty: This machine has no recorded maintenance activities.

maintenance-form.preventive-description: Record a preventive maintenance activity performed on a machine. Fields marked with * are required.
maintenance-form.corrective-description: Document the failure of a machine and the action taken to repair it. Fields marked with * are required.
maintenance-form.no-machines: Register a machine before recording maintenance.
maintenance-form.performed-at-hint: Date the activity was carried out.
maintenance-form.anomaly-hint: Optional anomaly code, for example ANM-2026-012.
